audit.why: 47.93% over 459 games; EVEN / 6-10 fits a lane Fiora owns for two levels and loses from the first crit item onward. The page's own prose already frames it that way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 were flattened to 'Skill' and Level 2 was given to Tryndamere, all four against the packet chart and the page's own whys[].
audit.why: whys[0] 'Q a vital and chip him for free' and whys[1] 'your biggest pre-scaling punish' are both Fiora rows. whys[3] describes him kiting your Lunges — a Tryndamere row. whys[4] calls level 6 'your kill window'. The packet chart (Fiora/Fiora/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Fiora/Tryndamere/Tryndamere) matches the prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 and 2 -> Fiora, Levels 4-5 -> Tryndamere, Level 6 -> Fiora, with phases[1], [3] and [4] whys rewritten so the reasons match.

audit.why: The page already states the decisive interaction correctly: nothing in Tryndamere's kit immobilizes — Mocking Shout is a slow on backs-turned targets, Spinning Slash is a plain dash, Bloodlust is a self-heal, Undying Rage is a death-prevention — so Riposte never returns a stun here and exists only to eat a crit. Missing were the numbers: Undying Rage 120/100/80s, Mocking Shout 14s, Spinning Slash 12/11/10/9/8s, Bloodlust 12s.
audit.corrected: Attach Undying Rage's 80s rank-3 cooldown and Spinning Slash's 8s rank-5 cooldown to the advice that already exists.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames entries are false positives: 'Mocking Shout's' and "Grand Challenge's" are the correct names with possessives, and 'Bank Fury' in wants.foe[0] is a verb phrase about the Battle Fury resource, not a mangled ability name.

edits.before: W is your matchup answer; hold it for HIS key spell only. Only take the trade when Tryndamere's Undying Rage is down.
edits.after: Level 2 Q into Bladework crits a Vital before he banks any Fury or crit chance — your hardest punish all game.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Undying Rage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Tryndamere's window: Mocking Shout slows you on 14s and his crit autos kite your Lunges. Nothing here returns a Riposte stun.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks four Vitals and its heal field out-sustains his auto DPS — but only if you commit while Undying Rage is on cooldown.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then duel. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 80s at rank 3. Wait it out, then duel — never before it.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is an 8s dash at rank 5 and Mocking Shout slows you from behind — you lose that footrace.

notes: The content prose on this page is already accurate about the key interaction (no immobilize in Tryndamere's kit, so Riposte never stuns); only the chart and the missing cooldown numbers needed work. All three packet suspectNames hits are false positives.
